#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Publish independent Gazebo model-pose telemetry for the private D2 demo.

This is an observation path, never a velocity publisher or a TF authority.
Wheel-integrated odometry is deliberately not used to construct this pose.
"""
import math

import rclpy
from gz.msgs10.pose_v_pb2 import Pose_V
from gz.transport13 import Node as GazeboNode
from nav_msgs.msg import Odometry


def planar_velocity(previous, current):
    """Return body-frame vx/vy and yaw rate from consecutive truth samples."""
    dt = (current[0] - previous[0]) / 1e9
    if dt <= 0 or dt > 0.5:
        return None
    vx = (current[1] - previous[1]) / dt
    vy = (current[2] - previous[2]) / dt
    yaw = current[3]
    dyaw = math.atan2(math.sin(yaw - previous[3]), math.cos(yaw - previous[3]))
    return (math.cos(yaw) * vx + math.sin(yaw) * vy,
            -math.sin(yaw) * vx + math.cos(yaw) * vy, dyaw / dt)


class GroundTruth:
    def __init__(self):
        self.node = rclpy.create_node("phase6_demo_ground_truth")
        self.publisher = self.node.create_publisher(
            Odometry, "/robot_1/demo/ground_truth", 10)
        self.previous = None
        self.gz = GazeboNode()
        if not self.gz.subscribe(Pose_V, "/world/sim_world/dynamic_pose/info",
                                 self.on_pose):
            raise RuntimeError("could not subscribe to Gazebo model poses")

    def on_pose(self, message):
        stamp = message.header.stamp
        ns = stamp.sec * 1_000_000_000 + stamp.nsec
        if self.previous is not None and ns < self.previous[0]:
            self.previous = None  # New simulator epoch, not a velocity impulse.
        if self.previous is not None and ns - self.previous[0] < 50_000_000:
            return
        pose = next((p for p in message.pose if p.name == "robot_1"), None)
        if pose is None:
            return  # No heartbeat without an actual model-pose observation.
        q = pose.orientation
        yaw = math.atan2(2 * (q.w * q.z + q.x * q.y),
                         1 - 2 * (q.y * q.y + q.z * q.z))
        current = (ns, pose.position.x, pose.position.y, yaw)
        velocity = planar_velocity(self.previous, current) if self.previous else None
        self.previous = current
        if velocity is None:
            return  # Need two fresh samples to assert a measured velocity.
        result = Odometry()
        result.header.frame_id = "map"
        result.header.stamp.sec = stamp.sec
        result.header.stamp.nanosec = stamp.nsec
        result.child_frame_id = "base_footprint"
        result.pose.pose.position.x = pose.position.x
        result.pose.pose.position.y = pose.position.y
        result.pose.pose.position.z = pose.position.z
        result.pose.pose.orientation.x = q.x
        result.pose.pose.orientation.y = q.y
        result.pose.pose.orientation.z = q.z
        result.pose.pose.orientation.w = q.w
        result.twist.twist.linear.x, result.twist.twist.linear.y = velocity[:2]
        result.twist.twist.angular.z = velocity[2]
        self.publisher.publish(result)


def main():
    rclpy.init()
    telemetry = GroundTruth()
    try:
        rclpy.spin(telemetry.node)
    finally:
        telemetry.node.destroy_node()
        rclpy.shutdown()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -Eeo pipefail

export HOME=/tmp/ros-home
mkdir -p "${HOME}/.ros" "${HOME}/.config" /tmp/semantic-navigation
export ROS_HOME="${HOME}/.ros"
export ROS_LOG_DIR="${HOME}/.ros/log"
export ROS_DOMAIN_ID="${ROS_DOMAIN_ID:-0}"
export RMW_IMPLEMENTATION=rmw_cyclonedds_cpp
export GZ_IP="${GZ_IP:-127.0.0.1}"
export GZ_PARTITION="${GZ_PARTITION:-hotel_nav2_rmf}"

source /opt/ros/jazzy/setup.bash
source /opt/rmf_demos_ws/install/setup.bash
if [[ "${SEMANTIC_CAPTURE_TRACE:-0}" == "1" ]]; then
  export LD_LIBRARY_PATH="/opt/semantic-navigation/capture-lib:${LD_LIBRARY_PATH:-}"
fi
set -u

ASSET_DIR=/opt/ros2-demo/hotel-assets
WORLD=/tmp/semantic-navigation/hotel.world
cp "${ASSET_DIR}/hotel.world" "${WORLD}"
if [[ "${SEMANTIC_PHASE2_SCENE:-0}" == "1" ]]; then
  python3 /opt/semantic-navigation/install_phase1_camera.py "${WORLD}" --phase2-targets
else
  python3 /opt/semantic-navigation/install_phase1_camera.py "${WORLD}"
fi
export GZ_SIM_RESOURCE_PATH="${ASSET_DIR}/models:${ASSET_DIR}:/opt/rmf_demos_ws/install/share/rmf_demos_assets/models:${GZ_SIM_RESOURCE_PATH:-}"
export GZ_SIM_SYSTEM_PLUGIN_PATH="/opt/ros/jazzy/opt/gz_sim_vendor/lib/gz-sim-8/plugins:${GZ_SIM_SYSTEM_PLUGIN_PATH:-}"
export QT_QPA_PLATFORM=xcb
export QT_X11_NO_MITSHM=1
export DISPLAY="${DISPLAY:-:99}"
VNC_PORT="${VNC_PORT:-5900}"
NOVNC_PORT="${NOVNC_PORT:-6080}"

pids=()
cleanup() {
  trap - TERM INT EXIT
  for pid in "${pids[@]:-}"; do kill "${pid}" 2>/dev/null || true; done
  wait || true
}
trap cleanup TERM INT EXIT

Xorg "${DISPLAY}" -config /etc/X11/xorg-dummy.conf -nolisten tcp \
  -logfile /tmp/Xorg.semantic-navigation.log & pids+=("$!")
sleep 2
openbox >/tmp/openbox.semantic-navigation.log 2>&1 & pids+=("$!")
x11vnc -display "${DISPLAY}" -rfbport "${VNC_PORT}" -shared -forever -nopw -noxdamage -noscr \
  >/tmp/x11vnc.semantic-navigation.log 2>&1 & pids+=("$!")
websockify --web /usr/share/novnc "${NOVNC_PORT}" "localhost:${VNC_PORT}" \
  >/tmp/novnc.semantic-navigation.log 2>&1 & pids+=("$!")

gz sim --force-version 8 -r -s -v 2 "${WORLD}" >/tmp/gz-server.semantic-navigation.log 2>&1 &
pids+=("$!")
sleep 3
gz sim --force-version 8 -g -v 2 "${WORLD}" >/tmp/gz-gui.semantic-navigation.log 2>&1 &
pids+=("$!")
# Match rmf-hotel-world-openshift-ai's smoothed overhead GUI follow mode.
# The supervisor below handles recovery, but does not attach at startup.
# Wait for both the service and tracking subscriber: publishing earlier races
# the GUI scene. Bounded startup retries leave later manual pan/zoom alone.
initialize_camera_follow() {
  for _attempt in $(seq 1 90); do
    if timeout 3 gz service -i -s /gui/follow 2>/dev/null |
        grep -q 'gz.msgs.StringMsg, gz.msgs.Boolean' &&
        timeout 4 gz service -s /gui/follow \
          --reqtype gz.msgs.StringMsg --reptype gz.msgs.Boolean \
          --timeout 3000 --req 'data: "robot_1"' 2>/dev/null |
        grep -q 'data: true' &&
        timeout 4 gz service -s /gui/follow/offset \
          --reqtype gz.msgs.Vector3d --reptype gz.msgs.Boolean \
          --timeout 3000 --req 'x: 0 y: 0 z: 5' 2>/dev/null |
        grep -q 'data: true' &&
        timeout 3 gz topic -i -t /gui/track 2>/dev/null |
        grep -q 'Subscribers'; then
      for _publish in $(seq 1 3); do
        timeout 2 gz topic -t /gui/track -m gz.msgs.CameraTrack \
          -p 'track_mode: FOLLOW_LOOK_AT follow_target: {name: "robot_1"} track_target: {name: "robot_1"} follow_offset: {x: 0 y: 0 z: 5} track_offset: {x: 0 y: 0 z: 0} follow_pgain: 0.02 track_pgain: 0.02' \
          >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
        sleep 0.5
      done
      echo "[semantic-navigation] Gazebo camera following robot_1 (overhead)"
      return 0
    fi
    sleep 1
  done
  echo "[semantic-navigation] camera follow initialization timed out" >&2
  return 1
}
initialize_camera_follow >/tmp/camera-follow-startup.semantic-navigation.log 2>&1 &
pids+=("$!")
python3 /opt/ros2-demo/scripts/camera_follow_supervisor.py >/tmp/camera-follow.semantic-navigation.log 2>&1 &
pids+=("$!")
ros2 run robot_state_publisher robot_state_publisher \
  --ros-args -p use_sim_time:=true \
  -p robot_description:="$(< /opt/ros2-demo/robot/turtlebot3_waffle.urdf)" \
  -r /tf:=/robot_1/tf -r /tf_static:=/robot_1/tf_static \
  >/tmp/robot-state-publisher.semantic-navigation.log 2>&1 &
pids+=("$!")

ros2 run ros_gz_bridge parameter_bridge \
  /clock@rosgraph_msgs/msg/Clock[gz.msgs.Clock \
  /robot_1/cmd_vel@geometry_msgs/msg/Twist]gz.msgs.Twist \
  /robot_1/odom@nav_msgs/msg/Odometry[gz.msgs.Odometry \
  /scan@sensor_msgs/msg/LaserScan[gz.msgs.LaserScan \
  --ros-args -r /scan:=/robot_1/scan >/tmp/gz-bridge.semantic-navigation.log 2>&1 &
pids+=("$!")
ros2 launch ros_gz_bridge ros_gz_bridge.launch.py \
  bridge_name:=semantic_camera_bridge \
  config_file:=/opt/ros2-demo/config/semantic-camera-bridge.yaml \
  >/tmp/rgbd-bridge.semantic-navigation.log 2>&1 &
pids+=("$!")

echo "[semantic-navigation] isolated hotel simulator with RGB-D camera ready"
wait "${pids[4]}"

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -Ee -o pipefail
export HOME="${HOME:-/tmp/phase6-nav2-home}"
export ROS_HOME="${ROS_HOME:-${HOME}/.ros}"
export ROS_LOG_DIR="${ROS_LOG_DIR:-${ROS_HOME}/log}"
mkdir -p "${ROS_LOG_DIR}"
source /opt/ros/jazzy/setup.bash
source /opt/semantic-costmap-ws/install/setup.bash
wait_for_topic() {
  local topic="$1"
  for attempt in {1..30}; do
    if timeout 3 ros2 topic echo "$topic" --once >/dev/null 2>&1; then
      return 0
    fi
    sleep 1
  done
  echo "required D2 input did not become live: $topic" >&2
  return 1
}
# The simulator and its bridge start independently. Give the adapter sidecars
# time to establish live inputs before Nav2's lifecycle manager activates its
# costmaps (which require odom->base TF immediately).
wait_for_topic /clock
wait_for_topic /odom
wait_for_topic /scan_fixed
wait_for_topic /tf
sleep 2

exec ros2 launch /opt/ros2-demo/nav2/hotel_nav2_federated_launch.py \
  map:="${PHASE6_MAP:-/opt/ros2-demo/maps/hotel_L1.yaml}" \
  params_file:="${PHASE6_PARAMS:-/phase6-nav2-config/phase6-demo-nav2-candidate.yaml}"
data.install_phase1_camera.py:
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Add the isolated semantic-navigation RGB-D sensor to a hotel world."""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import math
import os
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
from pathlib import Path


def add_camera(world_path: Path, robot_name: str = "robot_1") -> None:
    tree = ET.parse(world_path)
    model = tree.getroot().find(f".//model[@name='{robot_name}']")
    if model is None:
        raise ValueError(f"robot model {robot_name!r} not found in {world_path}")
    if model.find("link[@name='camera_link']") is not None:
        raise ValueError("camera_link already exists; refusing to patch twice")

    link = ET.SubElement(model, "link", {"name": "camera_link"})
    ET.SubElement(link, "pose", {"relative_to": "base_link"}).text = "0.11 0 0.15 0 0 0"
    inertial = ET.SubElement(link, "inertial")
    ET.SubElement(inertial, "mass").text = "0.01"
    inertia = ET.SubElement(inertial, "inertia")
    for name, value in (("ixx", "0.00001"), ("iyy", "0.00001"), ("izz", "0.00001"),
                        ("ixy", "0"), ("ixz", "0"), ("iyz", "0")):
        ET.SubElement(inertia, name).text = value

    sensor = ET.SubElement(link, "sensor", {"name": "rgbd_camera", "type": "rgbd_camera"})
    ET.SubElement(sensor, "always_on").text = "true"
    ET.SubElement(sensor, "update_rate").text = "10"
    ET.SubElement(sensor, "topic").text = f"/{robot_name}/camera"
    ET.SubElement(sensor, "gz_frame_id").text = "camera_color_optical_frame"
    camera = ET.SubElement(sensor, "camera")
    ET.SubElement(camera, "horizontal_fov").text = "1.04719755"
    image = ET.SubElement(camera, "image")
    ET.SubElement(image, "width").text = "640"
    ET.SubElement(image, "height").text = "480"
    ET.SubElement(image, "format").text = "R8G8B8"
    clip = ET.SubElement(camera, "clip")
    ET.SubElement(clip, "near").text = "0.15"
    ET.SubElement(clip, "far").text = "5.0"
    ET.SubElement(sensor, "visualize").text = "false"

    joint = ET.SubElement(model, "joint", {"name": "camera_joint", "type": "fixed"})
    ET.SubElement(joint, "parent").text = "base_link"
    ET.SubElement(joint, "child").text = "camera_link"

    tree.write(world_path, encoding="utf-8", xml_declaration=True)


def add_bridge_to_entrypoint(entrypoint_path: Path, bridge_config: str) -> None:
    script = entrypoint_path.read_text()
    marker = 'echo "[hotel-sim] Canonical federated Gazebo simulation ready"'
    if "semantic_camera_bridge" in script:
        raise ValueError("semantic camera bridge is already installed in entrypoint")
    if marker not in script:
        raise ValueError(f"expected startup marker not found in {entrypoint_path}")
    command = (
        'echo "[semantic-camera] Starting RGB-D Gazebo-to-ROS bridge"\n'
        f'ros2 launch ros_gz_bridge ros_gz_bridge.launch.py '
        f'bridge_name:=semantic_camera_bridge config_file:={bridge_config} &\n'
        'pids+=("$!")\n\n'
    )
    entrypoint_path.write_text(script.replace(marker, command + marker))


def add_phase2_targets(world_path: Path, *, phase6_demo: bool = False) -> None:
    """Add a recognizable mat and a visual distractor to the isolated world.

    ``phase6_demo`` is an explicit D2-only geometry variant: 1.2 m along
    the route and 1.95 m across it (three times the previous 0.65 m width).
    The Phase 2/fixture geometry remains unchanged for default callers.
    """
    tree = ET.parse(world_path)
    world = tree.getroot().find("world")
    if world is None:
        raise ValueError(f"world element not found in {world_path}")
    if world.find("model[@name='semantic_target_mat']") is not None:
        raise ValueError("Phase 2 target already exists; refusing to patch twice")

    def slab(name: str, x: float, y: float, sx: float, sy: float,
             color: tuple[float, float, float]) -> ET.Element:
        model = ET.Element("model", {"name": name})
        ET.SubElement(model, "static").text = "true"
        ET.SubElement(model, "pose").text = f"{x} {y} 0.005 0 0 0"
        link = ET.SubElement(model, "link", {"name": "surface"})
        visual = ET.SubElement(link, "visual", {"name": "visual"})
        visual_geometry = ET.SubElement(visual, "geometry")
        ET.SubElement(visual_geometry, "box")
        ET.SubElement(visual_geometry.find("box"), "size").text = f"{sx} {sy} 0.012"
        material = ET.SubElement(visual, "material")
        ET.SubElement(material, "ambient").text = f"{color[0]} {color[1]} {color[2]} 1"
        ET.SubElement(material, "diffuse").text = f"{color[0]} {color[1]} {color[2]} 1"
        return model

    # The validated hotel runtime pose is (15.4014, -31.5940, yaw≈0).
    # Place the target 2 m ahead; do not use the separate TB3 template pose.
    # 2.7 m (2026-10-30 prepared value) left only 0.30 m of runway between
    # the start and the hull-clearance envelope's west edge — the >65 deg
    # escape turn is kinematically infeasible for RPP and the robot cut the
    # corner into the envelope in every motion trial (notouch-run3/4:
    # canceled at 0.091 m hull clearance). 1.2 m keeps the direct route
    # blocked while giving ~1.05 m of runway before the envelope's west edge.
    mat_length_x = 1.2 if phase6_demo else 0.9
    # Widen only the standalone demo mat; keep its center, X length,
    # thickness, and the distractor unchanged.
    mat_width_y = 1.95 if phase6_demo else 0.65
    world.append(slab("semantic_target_mat", 17.4014, -31.5940, mat_length_x, mat_width_y,
                      (0.85, 0.08, 0.06)))
    # Similar footprint, but a neutral tile-like distractor, offset laterally.
    world.append(slab("semantic_distractor_tile", 17.4014, -30.0940, 0.9, 0.65,
                      (0.55, 0.52, 0.45)))
    tree.write(world_path, encoding="utf-8", xml_declaration=True)


def add_lighting_profile(world_path: Path, profile: str) -> None:
    """Apply a repeatable world lighting profile before Gazebo starts."""
    if profile == "baseline":
        return
    if profile != "dim":
        raise ValueError(f"unsupported lighting profile {profile!r}")
    tree = ET.parse(world_path)
    world = tree.getroot().find("world")
    if world is None:
        raise ValueError(f"world element not found in {world_path}")
    scene = world.find("scene")
    light = world.find("light[@name='sun']")
    if scene is None or light is None:
        raise ValueError("world must contain a scene and the directional light named 'sun'")
    scene.find("ambient").text = "0.08 0.08 0.08"
    scene.find("background").text = "0.12 0.12 0.12"
    light.find("diffuse").text = "0.25 0.25 0.25 1"
    light.find("specular").text = "0.05 0.05 0.05 1"
    tree.write(world_path, encoding="utf-8", xml_declaration=True)


WARMUP_CAMERA_TEMPLATE = """<model name="phase5_warmup_camera_{index}">
  <static>true</static>
  <pose>{x} {y} 0.15 0 0 {yaw}</pose>
  <link name="link">
    <sensor name="rgbd_camera" type="rgbd_camera">
      <always_on>true</always_on>
      <update_rate>5</update_rate>
      <topic>/phase5/warmup/{index}</topic>
      <gz_frame_id>phase5_warmup_{index}_optical</gz_frame_id>
      <camera>
        <horizontal_fov>1.8</horizontal_fov>
        <image><width>640</width><height>480</height><format>R8G8B8</format></image>
        <clip><near>0.15</near><far>5.0</far></clip>
      </camera>
      <visualize>false</visualize>
    </sensor>
  </link>
</model>"""


def add_phase6_render_warmup(world_path: Path, goal_xy) -> None:
    """Stage the pre-arm render-warmup cameras around the Phase 6 goal.

    User-approved October 28, 2026: the on-arm's goal-approach orbit sweeps
    the robot camera through scene content not seen on the detour route,
    and its FIRST render there costs ~190 ms of render-thread CPU (the root
    of the remaining endgame failure), delaying the gpu_lidar scan ~450 ms
    and the controller's TF wait ~76 ms past the 100 ms command authority.
    Twelve static, collision-less rgbd cameras: four at the goal facing
    N/E/S/W, and eight on the orbit circle (radius 1.3 m — the observed
    RPP goal-approach orbit radius) facing OUTWARD, matching the robot
    camera's actual viewpoints during the orbit (series-15 trial 000-on:
    the goal-centered set alone missed content visible from the orbit
    circle through parallax/occlusion — a fresh ~190 ms spike at sim 56.3).
    Each covers 1.8 rad of azimuth; the union covers every direction the
    orbit can expose within the main camera's 5 m far clip. The gz Sensors
    system never renders sensors without subscribers, so they cost nothing
    during the armed trial; the fixture subscribes each one briefly during
    the DISARMED startup (a few frames, forcing the lazy scene content to
    load), then unsubscribes and they deactivate again. Identical in BOTH
    arms so the paired scene and load stay identical.
    """
    text = world_path.read_text()
    if "phase5_warmup_camera_" in text:
        raise ValueError("warmup cameras already staged; refusing to patch twice")
    poses = []
    # Four goal-centered cameras facing N/E/S/W.
    for index in range(4):
        poses.append((goal_xy[0], goal_xy[1], index * math.pi / 2))
    # Eight cameras on the orbit circle facing outward, 45 deg apart.
    radius = 1.3
    for step in range(8):
        angle = math.pi / 8 + step * math.pi / 4
        poses.append((goal_xy[0] + radius * math.cos(angle),
                      goal_xy[1] + radius * math.sin(angle),
                      angle))
    models = "".join(WARMUP_CAMERA_TEMPLATE.format(
        index=index, x=x, y=y, yaw=yaw)
        for index, (x, y, yaw) in enumerate(poses))
    world_path.write_text(text.replace("</world>", models + "</world>"))


def main() -> None:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("world", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--robot", default="robot_1")
    parser.add_argument("--entrypoint", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--phase2-targets", action="store_true")
    parser.add_argument("--bridge-config", default="/opt/ros2-demo/config/semantic-camera-bridge.yaml")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    add_camera(args.world, args.robot)
    if args.phase2_targets:
        phase6_demo = os.environ.get("SEMANTIC_PHASE6_DEMO_TARGETS") == "1"
        if phase6_demo:
            # The un-supported simplified body pitches onto the floor; wheel
            # odometry can report a turn while the Gazebo body stays still.
            # Reuse the private fixture's supports ONLY in the opt-in D2 world.
            # No canonical SDF/URDF or qualified fixture is modified here.
            from support_geometry import add_rear_casters
            supported, _ = add_rear_casters(args.world.read_text(), "<robot/>")
            args.world.write_text(supported)
        add_phase2_targets(args.world, phase6_demo=phase6_demo)
    lighting_profile = os.environ.get("SEMANTIC_LIGHTING_PROFILE", "baseline")
    add_lighting_profile(args.world, lighting_profile)
    if args.entrypoint:
        add_bridge_to_entrypoint(args.entrypoint, args.bridge_config)
    print(f"Installed 640x480 RGB-D camera at 10 Hz on {args.robot}: {args.world}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

data.support_geometry.py:
"""Opt-in rear ball supports for the private simplified robot, not canonical assets.

Like upstream Waffle, use two freely rotating ball-joint casters. Locations are
adapted to this demo's smaller box hull; all existing collisions/inertias remain.
URDF represents spherical centres as fixed transforms (orientation is immaterial
to a sphere); dynamics are defined only by the Gazebo SDF ball joints.
"""
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET


CASTERS = (("rear_left_caster", -.14, .064), ("rear_right_caster", -.14, -.064))


def add_rear_casters(world_text, urdf_text):
    world,urdf=ET.fromstring(world_text),ET.fromstring(urdf_text)
    robot=world.find(".//model[@name='robot_1']")
    if robot is None or len(robot.findall("link/collision"))!=4:
        raise ValueError("expected original four-collision robot")
    base=robot.find("link[@name='base_link']/collision[@name='base_collision']")
    if (base is None or [float(x) for x in base.findtext("pose", "").split()]!=[-.032,0,.07,0,0,0]
            or [float(x) for x in base.findtext("geometry/box/size", "").split()]!=[.28,.31,.14]):
        raise ValueError("unqualified chassis geometry")
    for side in ("left","right"):
        wheel=robot.find(f"link[@name='wheel_{side}_link']")
        y=.144 if side=="left" else -.144
        if (wheel is None or [float(x) for x in wheel.findtext("pose", "").split()]!=[0,y,.023,-1.57,0,0]
                or float(wheel.findtext("collision/geometry/cylinder/radius", "nan"))!=.033):
            raise ValueError("unqualified wheel geometry")
    for name,x,y in CASTERS:
        if robot.find(f"link[@name='{name}']") is not None or urdf.find(f"link[@name='{name}']") is not None:
            raise ValueError("refusing duplicate caster")
        robot.append(ET.fromstring(f'''<link name="{name}"><pose>{x} {y} -0.005 0 0 0</pose>
          <inertial><mass>0.001</mass><inertia><ixx>1e-8</ixx><iyy>1e-8</iyy><izz>1e-8</izz></inertia></inertial>
          <collision name="support"><geometry><sphere><radius>0.005</radius></sphere></geometry>
            <surface><friction><ode><mu>1</mu><mu2>1</mu2></ode>
              <bullet><friction>1</friction><friction2>1</friction2></bullet></friction></surface></collision>
          <visual name="support"><geometry><sphere><radius>0.005</radius></sphere></geometry></visual></link>'''))
        robot.append(ET.fromstring(f'''<joint name="{name}_joint" type="ball">
          <parent>base_link</parent><child>{name}</child></joint>'''))
        urdf.append(ET.fromstring(f'''<link name="{name}">
          <collision><geometry><sphere radius="0.005"/></geometry></collision>
          <visual><geometry><sphere radius="0.005"/></geometry></visual></link>'''))
        urdf.append(ET.fromstring(f'''<joint name="{name}_centre" type="fixed">
          <parent link="base_link"/><child link="{name}"/><origin xyz="{x} {y} -0.005" rpy="0 0 0"/></joint>'''))
    return ET.tostring(world,encoding="unicode"),ET.tostring(urdf,encoding="unicode")

exec ros2 launch /opt/ros2-demo/nav2/hotel_nav2_federated_launch.py \
  map:="${PHASE6_MAP:-/opt/ros2-demo/maps/hotel_L1.yaml}" \
  params_file:="${PHASE6_PARAMS:-/phase6-nav2-config/phase6-demo-nav2-candidate.yaml}"","install_phase1_camera.py":"#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Add the isolated semantic-navigation RGB-D sensor to a hotel world."""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import math
import os
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
from pathlib import Path


def add_camera(world_path: Path, robot_name: str = "robot_1") -> None:
    tree = ET.parse(world_path)
    model = tree.getroot().find(f".//model[@name='{robot_name}']")
    if model is None:
        raise ValueError(f"robot model {robot_name!r} not found in {world_path}")
    if model.find("link[@name='camera_link']") is not None:
        raise ValueError("camera_link already exists; refusing to patch twice")

    link = ET.SubElement(model, "link", {"name": "camera_link"})
    ET.SubElement(link, "pose", {"relative_to": "base_link"}).text = "0.11 0 0.15 0 0 0"
    inertial = ET.SubElement(link, "inertial")
    ET.SubElement(inertial, "mass").text = "0.01"
    inertia = ET.SubElement(inertial, "inertia")
    for name, value in (("ixx", "0.00001"), ("iyy", "0.00001"), ("izz", "0.00001"),
                        ("ixy", "0"), ("ixz", "0"), ("iyz", "0")):
        ET.SubElement(inertia, name).text = value

    sensor = ET.SubElement(link, "sensor", {"name": "rgbd_camera", "type": "rgbd_camera"})
    ET.SubElement(sensor, "always_on").text = "true"
    ET.SubElement(sensor, "update_rate").text = "10"
    ET.SubElement(sensor, "topic").text = f"/{robot_name}/camera"
    ET.SubElement(sensor, "gz_frame_id").text = "camera_color_optical_frame"
    camera = ET.SubElement(sensor, "camera")
    ET.SubElement(camera, "horizontal_fov").text = "1.04719755"
    image = ET.SubElement(camera, "image")
    ET.SubElement(image, "width").text = "640"
    ET.SubElement(image, "height").text = "480"
    ET.SubElement(image, "format").text = "R8G8B8"
    clip = ET.SubElement(camera, "clip")
    ET.SubElement(clip, "near").text = "0.15"
    ET.SubElement(clip, "far").text = "5.0"
    ET.SubElement(sensor, "visualize").text = "false"

    joint = ET.SubElement(model, "joint", {"name": "camera_joint", "type": "fixed"})
    ET.SubElement(joint, "parent").text = "base_link"
    ET.SubElement(joint, "child").text = "camera_link"

    tree.write(world_path, encoding="utf-8", xml_declaration=True)


def add_bridge_to_entrypoint(entrypoint_path: Path, bridge_config: str) -> None:
    script = entrypoint_path.read_text()
    marker = 'echo "[hotel-sim] Canonical federated Gazebo simulation ready"'
    if "semantic_camera_bridge" in script:
        raise ValueError("semantic camera bridge is already installed in entrypoint")
    if marker not in script:
        raise ValueError(f"expected startup marker not found in {entrypoint_path}")
    command = (
        'echo "[semantic-camera] Starting RGB-D Gazebo-to-ROS bridge"\n'
        f'ros2 launch ros_gz_bridge ros_gz_bridge.launch.py '
        f'bridge_name:=semantic_camera_bridge config_file:={bridge_config} &\n'
        'pids+=("$!")\n\n'
    )
    entrypoint_path.write_text(script.replace(marker, command + marker))


def add_phase2_targets(world_path: Path, *, phase6_demo: bool = False) -> None:
    """Add a recognizable mat and a visual distractor to the isolated world.

    ``phase6_demo`` is an explicit D2-only geometry variant. It triples the
    mat's along-route X dimension while leaving the Phase 2/fixture geometry
    unchanged for every default caller.
    """
    tree = ET.parse(world_path)
    world = tree.getroot().find("world")
    if world is None:
        raise ValueError(f"world element not found in {world_path}")
    if world.find("model[@name='semantic_target_mat']") is not None:
        raise ValueError("Phase 2 target already exists; refusing to patch twice")

    def slab(name: str, x: float, y: float, sx: float, sy: float,
             color: tuple[float, float, float]) -> ET.Element:
        model = ET.Element("model", {"name": name})
        ET.SubElement(model, "static").text = "true"
        ET.SubElement(model, "pose").text = f"{x} {y} 0.005 0 0 0"
        link = ET.SubElement(model, "link", {"name": "surface"})
        visual = ET.SubElement(link, "visual", {"name": "visual"})
        visual_geometry = ET.SubElement(visual, "geometry")
        ET.SubElement(visual_geometry, "box")
        ET.SubElement(visual_geometry.find("box"), "size").text = f"{sx} {sy} 0.012"
        material = ET.SubElement(visual, "material")
        ET.SubElement(material, "ambient").text = f"{color[0]} {color[1]} {color[2]} 1"
        ET.SubElement(material, "diffuse").text = f"{color[0]} {color[1]} {color[2]} 1"
        return model

    # The validated hotel runtime pose is (15.4014, -31.5940, yaw≈0).
    # Place the target 2 m ahead; do not use the separate TB3 template pose.
    # 2.7 m (2026-10-30 prepared value) left only 0.30 m of runway between
    # the start and the hull-clearance envelope's west edge — the >65 deg
    # escape turn is kinematically infeasible for RPP and the robot cut the
    # corner into the envelope in every motion trial (notouch-run3/4:
    # canceled at 0.091 m hull clearance). 1.2 m keeps the direct route
    # blocked while giving ~1.05 m of runway for the ~33 deg exit diagonal.
    mat_length_x = 1.2 if phase6_demo else 0.9
    world.append(slab("semantic_target_mat", 17.4014, -31.5940, mat_length_x, 0.65,
                      (0.85, 0.08, 0.06)))
    # Similar footprint, but a neutral tile-like distractor, offset laterally.
    world.append(slab("semantic_distractor_tile", 17.4014, -30.0940, 0.9, 0.65,
                      (0.55, 0.52, 0.45)))
    tree.write(world_path, encoding="utf-8", xml_declaration=True)


def add_lighting_profile(world_path: Path, profile: str) -> None:
    """Apply a repeatable world lighting profile before Gazebo starts."""
    if profile == "baseline":
        return
    if profile != "dim":
        raise ValueError(f"unsupported lighting profile {profile!r}")
    tree = ET.parse(world_path)
    world = tree.getroot().find("world")
    if world is None:
        raise ValueError(f"world element not found in {world_path}")
    scene = world.find("scene")
    light = world.find("light[@name='sun']")
    if scene is None or light is None:
        raise ValueError("world must contain a scene and the directional light named 'sun'")
    scene.find("ambient").text = "0.08 0.08 0.08"
    scene.find("background").text = "0.12 0.12 0.12"
    light.find("diffuse").text = "0.25 0.25 0.25 1"
    light.find("specular").text = "0.05 0.05 0.05 1"
    tree.write(world_path, encoding="utf-8", xml_declaration=True)


WARMUP_CAMERA_TEMPLATE = """<model name="phase5_warmup_camera_{index}">
  <static>true</static>
  <pose>{x} {y} 0.15 0 0 {yaw}</pose>
  <link name="link">
    <sensor name="rgbd_camera" type="rgbd_camera">
      <always_on>true</always_on>
      <update_rate>5</update_rate>
      <topic>/phase5/warmup/{index}</topic>
      <gz_frame_id>phase5_warmup_{index}_optical</gz_frame_id>
      <camera>
        <horizontal_fov>1.8</horizontal_fov>
        <image><width>640</width><height>480</height><format>R8G8B8</format></image>
        <clip><near>0.15</near><far>5.0</far></clip>
      </camera>
      <visualize>false</visualize>
    </sensor>
  </link>
</model>"""


def add_phase6_render_warmup(world_path: Path, goal_xy) -> None:
    """Stage the pre-arm render-warmup cameras around the Phase 6 goal.

    User-approved October 28, 2026: the on-arm's goal-approach orbit sweeps
    the robot camera through scene content not seen on the detour route,
    and its FIRST render there costs ~190 ms of render-thread CPU (the root
    of the remaining endgame failure), delaying the gpu_lidar scan ~450 ms
    and the controller's TF wait ~76 ms past the 100 ms command authority.
    Twelve static, collision-less rgbd cameras: four at the goal facing
    N/E/S/W, and eight on the orbit circle (radius 1.3 m — the observed
    RPP goal-approach orbit radius) facing OUTWARD, matching the robot
    camera's actual viewpoints during the orbit (series-15 trial 000-on:
    the goal-centered set alone missed content visible from the orbit
    circle through parallax/occlusion — a fresh ~190 ms spike at sim 56.3).
    Each covers 1.8 rad of azimuth; the union covers every direction the
    orbit can expose within the main camera's 5 m far clip. The gz Sensors
    system never renders sensors without subscribers, so they cost nothing
    during the armed trial; the fixture subscribes each one briefly during
    the DISARMED startup (a few frames, forcing the lazy scene content to
    load), then unsubscribes and they deactivate again. Identical in BOTH
    arms so the paired scene and load stay identical.
    """
    text = world_path.read_text()
    if "phase5_warmup_camera_" in text:
        raise ValueError("warmup cameras already staged; refusing to patch twice")
    poses = []
    # Four goal-centered cameras facing N/E/S/W.
    for index in range(4):
        poses.append((goal_xy[0], goal_xy[1], index * math.pi / 2))
    # Eight cameras on the orbit circle facing outward, 45 deg apart.
    radius = 1.3
    for step in range(8):
        angle = math.pi / 8 + step * math.pi / 4
        poses.append((goal_xy[0] + radius * math.cos(angle),
                      goal_xy[1] + radius * math.sin(angle),
                      angle))
    models = "".join(WARMUP_CAMERA_TEMPLATE.format(
        index=index, x=x, y=y, yaw=yaw)
        for index, (x, y, yaw) in enumerate(poses))
    world_path.write_text(text.replace("</world>", models + "</world>"))


def main() -> None:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("world", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--robot", default="robot_1")
    parser.add_argument("--entrypoint", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--phase2-targets", action="store_true")
    parser.add_argument("--bridge-config", default="/opt/ros2-demo/config/semantic-camera-bridge.yaml")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    add_camera(args.world, args.robot)
    if args.phase2_targets:
        phase6_demo = os.environ.get("SEMANTIC_PHASE6_DEMO_TARGETS") == "1"
        add_phase2_targets(args.world, phase6_demo=phase6_demo)
    lighting_profile = os.environ.get("SEMANTIC_LIGHTING_PROFILE", "baseline")
    add_lighting_profile(args.world, lighting_profile)
    if args.entrypoint:
        add_bridge_to_entrypoint(args.entrypoint, args.bridge_config)
    print(f"Installed 640x480 RGB-D camera at 10 Hz on {args.robot}: {args.world}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
